# Optional independent observations

The default workflow uses a GloFAS-modelled proxy and does not require this
directory. To run an independent evaluation, place a licensed BWDB/FFWC
Hardinge Bridge series here as `hardinge_observations.csv`. The minimum schema
is shown in `example_observations.csv`.

Do not commit restricted or personally licensed data. Confirm the station identifier, datum, unit, quality flags, temporal aggregation, and redistribution terms with BWDB before analysis.
